title: Enough
subtitle: Security mistaken for connection
sourceCredit: Pete Goldfinger · The Moth Radio Hour, “Confidence Game”

shot.title: A room divided
shot.direction: Establish both adults at the same physical scale on one floor plane. The ledger barrier separates their guarded and waiting postures.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

shot.title: One formula fails
shot.direction: A single cell quivers, loses its formula, and settles. His pencil stops before his eyes lift.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

beats.caption: If I can fix these numbers, everything will be fine.
beats.speaker: MAN

shot.title: Another square
shot.direction: His pencil completes the mark on a square; the marked sheet slips into the growing wall.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

shot.title: Waiting beyond the glass
shot.direction: Her fingertips meet the glass. Keep him present, blurred by the wall; her face waits for a response.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

beats.caption: Can you see me over there?
beats.speaker: WIFE

shot.title: Can you see me
shot.direction: She asks once. Palm stays on glass while his gaze shifts from paper toward her.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

shot.title: The red numbers fall
shot.direction: Red arithmetic flakes downward. The physical wall remains after the symbols disappear.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

beats.caption: I thought losing the money did this.
beats.speaker: MAN

shot.title: An explanation runs out
shot.direction: He lowers the pencil and looks at the barrier instead of the balance sheet.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

beats.caption: You were behind that wall before any of it happened.
beats.speaker: WIFE

shot.title: The older wall
shot.direction: An older sheet ghosts into view as she names the distance that preceded the loss. Let his reaction follow her words.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

shot.title: The unguarded pause
shot.direction: His shoulders lose their defensive angle. Her hand stays available on the far side.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

beats.caption: Then I think I have to come out.
beats.speaker: MAN

shot.title: One open square
shot.direction: One square opens. He leaves the pencil, turns his torso, and begins crossing the gap.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

shot.title: A hand offered
shot.direction: He takes three short steps toward her, then reaches. Her hand meets his; the wall is still visible behind them.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

shot.title: Ink holds the connection
shot.direction: Movement diminishes around the joined hands. Do not add a moral or erase the history of the wall.
shot.soundDirection: Clock, paper-rustle, numbers dissolving into a single sustained warm chord.

production.sourceNotes: Conceptual dialogue. Avoid representing specific unverified words as factual quotation.
production.adaptationStatus: Whole-figure motion storyboard: anatomically complete pose drawings at a consistent ground scale, shared-room camera coverage, ledger-paper barrier, and a naturally joined-hands ending. Final film production remains separate.
